title: Watermelon Caprese Appetizer
description: Watermelon, mozzarella cheese, and basil appetizer skewers are drizzled with olive oil and balsamic vinegar in this fun twist on a caprese salad.
ingredients: 1 small watermelon, fruit removed with a melon baller
1 (8 ounce) package fresh mozzarella cheese, cut into small pieces
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Trim basil leaves into small circles about 1 inch in diameter.
Thread watermelon and mozzarella cheese on toothpicks, sandwiching a basil leaf in between. Arrange on a serving plate.
Pour olive oil and balsamic vinegar over toothpicks. Sprinkle salt and black pepper on top.

video.description: Get your backyard party started with these cute appetizers that pack big summer flavors! And making them couldn't be more simple! Grab toothpicks and thread on chilled cubes of juicy watermelon with creamy, fresh mozzarella and fragrant, green basil. Drizzle with a quick vinaigrette of balsamic vinegar and olive oil and season with salt and pepper and watch them all disappear faster than you can make them!
